description: This file defines a PHP class 'Reward' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail'. The class extends the base Controller class from the OpenCart system and is responsible for handling email notifications related to customer rewards. It includes a method 'index' which generates and sends reward notification emails to customers, including assembling email content, retrieving customer/store/language info, and configuring the email sending process.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending reward notifications via email to customers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that composes and sends a reward notification email to a customer based on provided route arguments: customer ID, description, points, and order ID.
